# Giving a discount on a single line of an order

You can take money off a single item on an order without discounting the whole order. This is useful for a goodwill gesture, a damaged print, a trade rate on one product, or matching a price you quoted.

## Discount an item as you add it

1. Go to **Orders** and click **New order from catalogue**.
2. Choose the product and make your selections as normal.
3. Under Quantity, use **Line discount (optional)** — pick **%** or your currency symbol and type the value.
4. The price box and the **Add to cart** button show the full price crossed out next to the new price. Click **Add to cart**.

![Manual Order Discount Pre Cart](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/078b0234-99dc-49a2-ae7b-a19335b324e4.png)

## Discount an item already in the cart

Each row in the cart has a **Disc.** box under Qty / Unit / Line. Choose % or currency, type the value, and the Line figure updates. Clear the box to remove the discount.

![Manual Order Discount In Cart](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/27bc4229-cfdf-40bb-8492-ed1724082981.png)

## What the customer is charged

The cart shows the full subtotal, the line discounts, and the figure after them. Any whole-order discount, minimum charge and sales tax are then worked out on the reduced figure, so tax is charged on what the customer actually pays.

## Where the discount shows afterwards

The item keeps a Discount note on the order, and it prints on production tickets, so anyone handling the job can see the price was reduced and by how much.

## Good to know

- There is no limit — you can discount right down to zero. A cash discount larger than the line is capped at the line value.
- The discount is applied to the nearest penny per item, so 10% off 10 prints at $0.65 comes out as $0.60 off. The amount shown is always the cash actually taken off.
- Duplicating an order copies the reduced price, not the discount note, so it is not applied twice.
- This is the order builder in OrderHub. The till has its own discount button, and quotes use the quote discount.
